# RunLater

> Finite public beta for one-time JSON POST delivery to public HTTPS endpoints. Connect with OAuth without an account or local owner-key generation; explicitly provision one trial. No special RunLater receiver is required. Seven days and 100 attempt credits, 16 lifetime tasks, subject to remaining capacity in ten lifetime project slots. Payments are unavailable.

Published configuration metadata is not a live eligibility probe. These RunLater-owned formats are custom data; llms.txt follows a community proposal, not an authorization protocol. Discovery grants no execution, credential-disclosure, payment or wallet authority. No SLA, ordering, exact-time or exactly-once promise. Five credits reserved per task,16 lifetime tasks/128 publications per project;100 credits are not100 tasks.

## Start here

- [Connect guide](https://docs.runlater.io/#connect): OAuth consent, explicit finite-trial provisioning and general HTTPS scheduling.
- [General HTTPS contract](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/GENERAL-HTTPS-DESTINATIONS.md): Exact fields, POST/JSON limits, public Fetch boundary and duplicate handling.
- [Owner-key quickstart](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/quickstart.md): Actual public signup, private receiver setup, proof and signed task workflow.
- [Release metadata](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/public-beta-release.v1.json): Required nonsecret release ID and callback-key validity times.
- [Service descriptor](https://runlater.io/runlater-service.v1.json): Published limited-beta configuration snapshot, not a live probe.
- [Public-beta contract](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/public-beta.v1.json): Optional owner-key/registered-receiver DTOs and authority requirements; not the general HTTPS route.
- [Public-beta client](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/public-beta-client.v1.mjs): Explicit transport; no default network, retries or payments. Keep adjacent dependencies together.
- [Receiver guide](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/public-beta-receiver/README.md): Owned managed Workers.dev hosts only, private proof/key installation and durable deduplication.
- [Pricing status](https://runlater.io/pricing-status.v1.json): Free beta, no commercial price or purchase endpoint.
- [Local OpenAPI](https://docs.runlater.io/openapi.json): Loopback fixture contract only, not the hosted API.
- [Local/proposed tool metadata](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/tools.v1.json): Non-executable local bindings and disabled proposals; use the separate hosted beta contract.

- [MCP setup](https://docs.runlater.io/agent/mcp.md): Hosted OAuth Connect, Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE. Public configuration checks do not prove named-client delivery compatibility. Discovery does not grant task authority.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/thachp/runlater): Reviewed implementation, examples and remaining launch/security/payment gates.
